findings.reason: Confirmed only as a narrower, low-severity prerequisite/cross-reference correction; the assertion that all four works are absent is false. I read all 15 prerequisite records, items 24/35, the published LOW paper at pp. 30–31 and 40–43, and the cited external statements. Klüners–Malle 2004 is already the second work in prerequisite 11, grouped with Klüners 2012. This is true both at the red team's own base c9e1212bfcbe14236ed26e6895958f905424729c and at this review's base 1098723. Do not add a duplicate; optionally split the existing compound record and attach its own DOI/public link. Its Corollary 7.3 applies to transitive prime-power groups, not arbitrary nilpotent permutation groups; Alberts supplies the latter extension. The proof using KM04 is on published p. 30, not p. 31. BSW15, EV06 and Alberts are absent from this extraction's prerequisites and are explicitly consumed on p. 41, so adding their precise local uses is warranted. However BSW15 already appears as source bhargava-global-fields-2015 in the partial ArithmeticStatistics packet, including the node ArithmeticStatistics:ST.3/bhargava-shankar-wang-counts-over-number-fields and proof gaps; reuse and cross-reference that work rather than describe it as wholly unknown to the atlas. EV06 is also already requested in PAPER-BHARGAVA-25 and PAPER-BHARGAVA-SHANKAR-WANG-22, for different locators. Add the Proposition 1.3 application here without scheduling a duplicate extraction. I checked BSW arXiv:1512.03035v1 Theorem 2 (pp. 2–3), which counts S_n extensions for n=2,3,4,5 with acceptable local specifications. LOW p. 41 uses it for a weighted relative h_3 asymptotic and the o(X) contribution of smaller Galois groups; the why field should retain that application and the class-field/cubic-count comparison, not suggest that the unweighted quadratic count alone is the weighted theorem. EV06 Proposition 1.3 (published p. 725) gives the Galois-extension bound for degree n>4; retain this range and treat the small regular degrees separately. Alberts arXiv:1804.11318v3 Corollary 1.8 gives the nilpotent transitive-group bound. The proposed Alberts DOI is wrong: the publisher identifies Research in Number Theory 6 (2020), article 10 with https://doi.org/10.1007/s40993-019-0185-7, not 10.1007/s40993-019-0181-x; https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.11318 is a public alternative. Correct fix: add the three missing source records with these qualifications and existing-work links; preserve/split rather than duplicate KM04; use the corrected DOI and version-specific theorem locators. No change to routing, theorem conclusions or severity is warranted by this finding.
